body:
Approved implementation plan (auto-approved gate, epic #99 autonomous run)

Docs-only. New docs/SITE_POLICY.md owns the site-policy system: precedence table (agent rule → global user → signed blocklist → default; tiers beat specificity; no agent tier without a key), domain matching (psl suffix walk; IP/localhost only via a per-agent *; non-network URLs allowed), global tier toggle semantics, the four worked examples with test citations, where the gate runs (checkpoints A/B, chain steps re-gated and the chain continues), the checked/exempt tool table, the blocked envelope, the fail-open cases (#100), storage tables and migrations 001-003, the event log, admin surfaces and WS events, the signed blocklist updater (fetched from GitHub main — not bundled; boot + every 24h — not hourly; cache; failure modes incl. #101), and the update procedure with both signing paths (local sign vs. merge-unsigned-and-release-stable-re-signs, CI hash check fails until re-signed) plus a "maintainer decision pending" note. Other docs link to it: MCP_SERVER.md (gate section condensed, endpoints table kept, source files, config key, cadence, WS events, data dir), MCP_INTEGRATION.md (corrected tool list, "bundled" fixed, Blocked-by-Site-Policy error section), CHROME_EXTENSION.md link, CONTRIBUTING.md ("Signing and updating the signed bundles" + blocklist update summary), ADDING_NEW_FEATURES.md TAB_ID_TOOLS note, SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS.md migration history, RELEASE.md heading reference, INDEX.md entry, README one-liner. Known gaps cite #100, #101, #110, #112.

Sub-tasks:
- [sub-task 1] Write docs/SITE_POLICY.md (complex)
- [sub-task 2] MCP_SERVER.md + SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS.md edits (standard)
- [sub-task 3] MCP_INTEGRATION.md edits (standard)
- [sub-task 4] CONTRIBUTING.md, ADDING_NEW_FEATURES.md, INDEX.md, CHROME_EXTENSION.md, RELEASE.md, README.md (standard)
- [sub-task 5] Cross-doc review: contradictions, ≥15 claim spot-checks, every link/anchor resolves, INDEX completeness, stale-term grep (review)
- [sub-task 6] Apply fix-ups (standard)

Flagged for the human gate at the epic end: the signing-key location policy conflict (SECURITY.md vs. the CI hash check), and the Sites card subtitle "Applies to all agents regardless of their custom rules" which contradicts per-agent precedence (UI copy from the epic).
